title: Completeness findings
description: What architecture-completeness-reviewer found in an Epic's detailed design before any spec is written: each value a spec would have to decide (criteria A15 to A20 of the effective-architecture review standard) and each contradiction between two approved documents. Consumed by the step that accepts it (orchestrator/flows/architecture_completeness.py), which files the findings for the solutions architect as the open design gaps of the completeness review.

Criterion.description: The criterion the finding is against: A15 to A20, or contradiction for two approved documents that state one fact differently.

element.description: The matrix id of the element the finding is about; empty for a contradiction that is about no one element.

documents.description: The documents the finding rests on, each by its path under the architecture root and heading, as <path>#<heading>: the home that leaves the value unstated first, or both documents of a contradiction.

finding.description: What is unstated or contradictory, in one or two sentences: the route, store, event value, name, idempotency key, timeout, internal structure or statement concerned.

correction.description: The bounded correction, with the condition that shows it is done; it states what must be decided, never the decision.

searched.description: Each element checked and each document read, one line each, so what was not looked at is visible.
